name: Shanghai Industrial Development Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Industrial Development Co.,Ltd develops, operates, sells, and manages real estate properties in China. It operates through the Real Estate Business, Property Services, and Other Business segments. The company offers property services for residential and commercial real estate; real estate information consulting; engineering management; business consulting; and business services. It also engages in investment management, asset management, and other businesses. Shanghai Industrial Development Co.,Ltd was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
